answer: Agents stake bonds on a shared mesa ledger, and each new identity must submit a multi-wavelength Raman LIDAR extinction profile whose depolarization ratio is calibrated against the live gale of atmospheric noise, binding identity to verifiable physical sensor provenance. Colluding identities that ride the same tide of forged backscatter are clustered by correlated optical. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
